opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid participation in Forsage by linking registration costs to claimed income: viewers are told, “you will register in slots 1,2 and 3” for Rp1,900,000 with possible income of Rp7,140,000 per cycle. It further ties returns to recruitment and tiered activity, stating that “Only 2 member that you recruit” are needed and that sponsoring someone brings “100% in bonus.” A slide also displays profit figures beside a cost figure, while the speaker directs interested viewers to download TrustWallet and make contact. Although the speaker describes dollars as free and presents the material as a review, the overall presentation solicits paid, recruitment-based participation. The records do not verify actual payments, returns, or withdrawals.
